description: Pattern-match engine v2 for TG Call Assist. Expanded to 60+ intents covering objections, discovery, service explanations, close moves, payment/billing, compliance, and branch availability. Styles grouped into 4 voice buckets (A/B/C/D) for efficient coverage. Each intent includes 2-3 raw mined examples from the 2,226-call corpus where available.

intents.label: Prospect refuses to give address / just wants a price

say_this_by_group.group_a: Totally understand - but we price by square footage, not a guess. If I quote blind, you'll either overpay or get a number that doesn't match your yard. Takes 10 seconds - what's the address?
say_this_by_group.group_b: The reason I need it: pricing comes from actual property square footage via satellite view. Without the address, any number I give is a rough estimate - and estimates usually run high because we assume the yard is bigger than it is.
say_this_by_group.group_c: I understand. Pricing is calculated from verified property measurements. May I confirm the service address so I can provide accurate pricing rather than an estimate?
say_this_by_group.group_d: No pressure at all - the address is just so I can measure the yard accurately. It's for the quote only. Would you be okay sharing it just for that purpose?

intents.then: Secure the address, then move to Discovery. If still refuses, give rough per-sq-ft range and offer to call back when ready.
intents.check: Address required for accurate pricing - do NOT quote without verified property size.

intents.label: Which services to bundle based on customer concerns

say_this_by_group.group_a: Lead with the lawn program (always), then layer in what matches. Mosquitoes = add TruDefense. Bugs or ants inside = TruBarrier. Tree issues like bagworms = TruShrub. Price everything together to show the bundle discount.
say_this_by_group.group_b: Bundle logic by stated concern: 1) Lawn program always first. 2) Mosquito mention = TruDefense monthly. 3) Insect/pest = TruBarrier perimeter. 4) Tree or shrub issue (bagworms are tree & shrub pest) = TruShrub. 5) Present the full bundle total side-by-side with piece-by-piece pricing so they see the savings.
say_this_by_group.group_c: Recommended bundle: Core lawn program as foundation; TruDefense Mosquito for outdoor comfort concerns; TruShrub for tree and shrub issues including bagworms; TruBarrier for perimeter pest concerns. Present bundled pricing to demonstrate savings over individual service pricing.
say_this_by_group.group_d: Build around what they told you. Lawn's always the base. Said mosquitoes? Add TruDefense. Mentioned bagworms? That's a tree & shrub thing - add TruShrub. Show the bundled price so it feels like a win for them.

intents.then: Build the bundle: start with lawn program, add specific services matching each concern, present combined price with bundle discount shown. Then move to Close.
intents.check: Verify bundle discount percentage and current pricing in TruView before quoting.

intents.label: Do Not Call request (compliance)
triggers: put me on (?:the )?(?:do not call|dnc) list

say_this_by_group.group_a: Absolutely — I'll take you off the list right now. One sec. (DO NOT push, DO NOT re-pitch. Process DNC immediately in TruView.)
say_this_by_group.group_b: Understood — processing that now. (Immediate DNC processing required by compliance. No further pitching.)
say_this_by_group.group_c: Of course. I am processing your Do Not Call request now. You will not receive further contact from us. May I confirm your phone number for the request?
say_this_by_group.group_d: Totally understand — I'll take care of that right now. No further calls from us. Have a good one.

intents.then: COMPLIANCE: Process DNC in TruView immediately. Do NOT pitch, do NOT ask for a reason. End call politely.
intents.check: DNC must be processed in TruView within 10 business days. Compliance critical.

intents.label: Customer complaint / angry

say_this_by_group.group_a: Hear me out — I'm sorry, let me understand what happened. Walk me through it from the start.
say_this_by_group.group_b: Here's what I'll do: listen fully to what happened, log the specifics, flag it to the branch, and get back to you by end of day with a resolution. Can you walk me through?
say_this_by_group.group_c: I apologize for the issue. May I ask you to describe exactly what occurred so I can document it accurately and route it to the appropriate team for resolution?
say_this_by_group.group_d: I'm so sorry about that — totally understand you're frustrated. Walk me through what happened and let's figure out how to fix it.

intents.then: Do NOT upsell, do NOT push. Listen, log details, route to branch, follow up.
intents.check: COMPLIANCE: All complaints must be logged in TruView within same business day. Follow escalation protocol.

intents.label: Tech didn't show / missed appointment

say_this_by_group.group_a: I'm sorry about that. Let me check what happened and reschedule. What day was it?
say_this_by_group.group_b: Here's what I'll do: investigate what happened with the scheduled visit, reschedule for the next available slot, and credit the account if applicable.
say_this_by_group.group_c: I apologize for the service interruption. May I review the scheduled visit, arrange rescheduling, and determine if any account credit is applicable?
say_this_by_group.group_d: I'm so sorry — let me look into it right now and get you rescheduled. What day was the missed visit?

intents.then: Pull service history in TruView to confirm missed visit. Reschedule and apply credit per policy.
intents.check: COMPLIANCE: Missed visit must be documented and resolved per service recovery protocol.

intents.label: Wrong property / wrong house serviced

say_this_by_group.group_a: Serious one — let me pull it up right now. What address was supposed to be treated vs what got treated?
say_this_by_group.group_b: Here's what I'll do: pull the service record immediately, confirm the actual property treated vs intended, document everything, and escalate to the branch for resolution.
say_this_by_group.group_c: I will immediately access the service record to determine the treatment deviation, document the incident, and escalate to the branch for formal resolution.
say_this_by_group.group_d: I'm so sorry about that — let me look at it right now. What was supposed to be treated vs what actually happened?

intents.then: URGENT: Pull service record, document in TruView, escalate to branch same day.
intents.check: COMPLIANCE: Wrong-property treatment is a critical service failure. Follow incident protocol immediately.

intents.label: Charged twice / double billed

say_this_by_group.group_a: Serious one — let me look. If there's a duplicate charge, we refund it. What's the account?
say_this_by_group.group_b: I'll review the billing immediately to identify any duplicate charges. Refunds are issued for billing errors. May I have the account information?
say_this_by_group.group_c: I will review your billing to identify any duplicate charges. Refunds are initiated for confirmed billing errors. May I obtain your account information?
say_this_by_group.group_d: Let me look at it — if there's a double charge, we refund it. What's the address?

intents.then: Review billing in TruView, identify duplicates, initiate refund per policy.
intents.check: COMPLIANCE: Billing disputes require documentation and timely refund processing.

intents.label: Tech didn't finish / partial service

say_this_by_group.group_a: That's not right — let me get a tech back out to finish. What areas got missed?
say_this_by_group.group_b: I apologize — incomplete service is a service failure. I will dispatch a technician to complete the remaining areas. Which sections were missed?
say_this_by_group.group_c: I apologize for the incomplete service. A technician will be dispatched to complete the remaining treatment areas. May I identify the areas requiring completion?
say_this_by_group.group_d: That shouldn't happen — I'll send someone back to finish. What was missed?

intents.then: Document incomplete service in TruView, schedule return visit immediately.
intents.check: COMPLIANCE: Incomplete service documentation and resolution required.

intents.label: Fertilizer burn / treatment damage

say_this_by_group.group_a: Fertilizer burn is a treatment issue — covered by the guarantee. Let me get a tech out to assess and apply recovery treatment at no charge.
say_this_by_group.group_b: Here's the fertilizer burn response: this falls under the guarantee. Recovery treatment includes watering, time, and potentially iron supplementation. Scheduled at no cost.
say_this_by_group.group_c: Fertilizer burn is addressed under the TruGreen Guarantee. Recovery treatment protocols are applied at no cost to the customer.
say_this_by_group.group_d: Guarantee covers that — I'll get a tech out to look and fix it free.

intents.then: Schedule guarantee recovery visit in TruView.
intents.check: COMPLIANCE: Treatment damage requires documented guarantee follow-up.

intents.label: Well water / private well

say_this_by_group.group_a: Well water matters — we're careful to protect wellheads. Tech sets a buffer around the well so no treatment product gets near it.
say_this_by_group.group_b: Here's the well protection protocol: setback distances are maintained around wellheads to prevent any treatment product from reaching the water supply.
say_this_by_group.group_c: Private well sources receive protective setback zones to prevent contamination. Technicians are trained in wellhead protection protocols.
say_this_by_group.group_d: Well water — tech sets a buffer around the well so nothing gets near it. We're careful.

intents.then: Note well location in TruView — critical for tech wellhead protection.
intents.check: COMPLIANCE: Wellhead setback requirements may be regulated at state level.

intents.label: Termites

say_this_by_group.group_a: We don't do termites — that's a licensed termite control company. Totally different service. We can refer you to one though.
say_this_by_group.group_b: Here's the termite scope: TruGreen does not treat termites. Termite control requires specialized licensure and inspection protocols. We recommend a dedicated termite control company.
say_this_by_group.group_c: Termite control is specifically outside TruGreen's service portfolio due to specialized licensure requirements. We recommend consultation with a licensed termite control provider.
say_this_by_group.group_d: We don't do termites — that's a specific pest control thing. Totally separate industry. Can point you to someone though.

intents.then: If customer has termites, provide referral guidance.
intents.check: COMPLIANCE: DO NOT promise termite treatment — not an approved TG service.

intents.label: Cockroaches / roaches

say_this_by_group.group_a: Perimeter pest handles outdoor roaches around the foundation. For indoor roach infestations, you'd want a dedicated indoor pest control service — different scope.
say_this_by_group.group_b: Here's the roach distinction: TruBarrier perimeter treats outdoor areas (around foundation, mulch, etc). Indoor roach infestations require interior pest control, which is a different service we don't provide.
say_this_by_group.group_c: TruBarrier perimeter services address exterior roach populations near the structural perimeter. Interior infestations require specialized indoor pest control services, outside our scope.
say_this_by_group.group_d: Outside roaches we handle through perimeter pest. If they're inside the house, that's a different thing — you'd need an indoor exterminator.

intents.then: If customer has indoor roaches, refer out to indoor pest control.
intents.check: DO NOT promise indoor cockroach treatment — not approved TruGreen service.

intents.label: Carpenter ants

say_this_by_group.group_a: Carpenter ants are tough — perimeter pest covers them outside the house. If they're in the house (wood damage, sawdust), that's a licensed pest control thing.
say_this_by_group.group_b: Here's the carpenter ant distinction: TruBarrier handles exterior perimeter populations. Established interior colonies (indicated by wood damage/frass) require specialized termite/wood-damaging pest treatment.
say_this_by_group.group_c: Exterior carpenter ant populations are addressed via TruBarrier services. Interior infestations indicated by structural wood damage require specialized pest treatment.
say_this_by_group.group_d: Outside carpenter ants we got through perimeter pest. If they're inside the house eating wood, you need a different kind of pest control.

intents.then: If customer has indoor carpenter ant damage, refer out.
intents.check: DO NOT promise interior carpenter ant/wood-damage pest control.

intents.label: How to explain the TruGreen guarantee

say_this_by_group.group_a: Say: 'TruGreen guarantee: if the lawn's not where it should be between visits, we come back and re-treat at no charge. No questions, no extra bill. That's the whole program's backbone.'
say_this_by_group.group_b: The way the guarantee works: 'Every service we do is backed by it. If results aren't where you want them between scheduled visits — weeds, color, thickness — you call us and we come out. No cost. That's why we're confident putting it in writing.'
say_this_by_group.group_c: Say: 'The TruGreen Guarantee means that between scheduled visits, if results are not meeting expectations, we will return at no cost to perform additional treatments. It applies to every service in your program.'
say_this_by_group.group_d: Keep it simple: 'If it's not working between visits, we come back free. Call us, we show up, no bill. That's it.'

intents.then: Use the guarantee as a close reinforcement when price objection appears.
mined_examples: Crocker, is backed by our guarantee.
everything is backed by our guarantee
um, everything backed by our guarantee

intents.label: How to explain the lawn program

say_this_by_group.group_a: Say: 'Our tech comes out every 4-6 weeks — that's 7-8 visits a year. Each visit is timed to what the lawn needs that season: pre-emergent in spring, weed control + fertilizer through summer, aeration in fall. Backed by the TruGreen guarantee.'
say_this_by_group.group_b: The way to frame it: 'Think of it as a schedule, not a one-time treatment. 7-8 visits a year, each one timed to what the lawn needs: pre-emergent to stop weeds, fertilizer for color, aeration to break up compacted soil. All backed by the guarantee.'
say_this_by_group.group_c: Say: 'The program includes 7-8 scheduled visits per year. Each visit is seasonally timed: pre-emergent in spring to prevent weeds, fertilization through summer, aeration in fall. Everything is backed by the TruGreen Guarantee.'
say_this_by_group.group_d: Keep it simple: 'We come out every 4-6 weeks, 7-8 times a year. Each visit does what the lawn needs that season — weed prevention, fertilization, aeration. If something's not working, we come back free. That's the guarantee.'

intents.then: After the explanation, pivot to tree/shrub, mosquito, or pest based on prior discovery answers.
mined_examples: We do 8 applications a year.
we do have our, uh, True pro program, uh
See here we do have our true pro program, OK.

intents.label: How to explain tree & shrub program

say_this_by_group.group_a: Say: 'TruShrub program — up to 7 visits a year. Dormant oil in winter to kill overwintering pests, root fertilization for health, insect and disease control through growing season. Keeps the trees and shrubs healthy and looking right.'
say_this_by_group.group_b: The frame: 'Trees and shrubs need different care than lawn. Our program hits them 7 times a year: dormant oil in winter kills pests before they hatch, root fertilization goes directly to the soil for maximum uptake, and we treat for insects and disease through the growing season.'
say_this_by_group.group_c: Say: 'The tree & shrub program includes up to 7 scheduled visits: dormant oil applications, root zone fertilization, insect/disease control, and recovery treatments. Everything is backed by the TruGreen Guarantee.'
say_this_by_group.group_d: Keep it simple: 'Up to 7 visits a year — dormant oil in winter, root fertilizer for growth, pest and disease control through the growing season. Keeps the plants healthy without you having to think about it.'

intents.then: After this, use it as a hook for Mosquito or Perimeter Pest.
mined_examples: We do tree and shrub care.
we do tree and shrub care as well
So we, we offer tree and shrub care.

intents.label: How to explain mosquito program

say_this_by_group.group_a: Say: 'TruDefense Mosquito — we target every spot mosquitoes live and rest on the property. Monthly treatments during mosquito season, each one lasts about 30 days. Mosquito-Free Guarantee — if you see biting mosquitoes between treatments, we re-treat free.'
say_this_by_group.group_b: Here's how it works: 'Mosquitoes live in specific spots — mulch beds, shrubs, shaded corners. Our tech targets each of those with a formula that kills within 24 hours and lasts about 30 days. We're there monthly during the season.'
say_this_by_group.group_c: Say: 'The mosquito program involves monthly treatments during mosquito season. Each treatment lasts approximately 30 days and includes the Mosquito-Free Guarantee — if you see biting mosquitoes between treatments, we re-treat at no cost.'
say_this_by_group.group_d: Keep it simple: 'Monthly treatments during mosquito season. Lasts about 30 days each time. If you still see mosquitoes between visits, we come back free. That's it.'

intents.then: After this, pivot to Perimeter Pest.
mined_examples: Uh, we have our, uh, true defense.
Well, we have a great um mosquito program.
yeah, we do have our True Defense plus program

intents.label: How to explain perimeter pest / TruBarrier

say_this_by_group.group_a: Say: 'TruBarrier — 3-5 foot barrier around the foundation. 4 applications a year, seasonally rotated. Treats windows, doors, entry points. Stops spiders, ants, roaches, earwigs from getting inside.'
say_this_by_group.group_b: The way it works: 'We create a protective band 3-5 feet around the foundation. 4 applications a year, each one timed to when pests seek shelter inside. Covers spiders, ants, roaches, earwigs, stink bugs.'
say_this_by_group.group_c: Say: 'TruBarrier includes 4 applications per year that create a 3-5 foot protective perimeter around the foundation. Entry points like windows and doors are treated, and seasonal product rotation targets pests when they're most active.'
say_this_by_group.group_d: Keep it simple: '4 treatments a year, 3-5 foot barrier around the house. Stops bugs before they get inside. You don't have to be home.'

intents.then: Return to Close + Payment with full bundle calculated.
mined_examples: We have our true barrier perimeter pest.
Then we have the perimeter pest control.
Uh, we have our true barrier perimeter pest.

intents.label: How to explain aeration + overseeding

say_this_by_group.group_a: Say: 'Aeration is a machine that pulls small plugs out of the soil — breaks up compaction so air, water, and nutrients can get to the roots. We overseed at the same time to fill in thin areas. One time a year, usually fall.'
say_this_by_group.group_b: The reason aeration matters: 'Over time, soil gets compacted — foot traffic, mowers, weather. That means water and fertilizer can't reach the roots. Aeration pulls plugs out, breaks it up, and the roots breathe again. Overseeding fills in bare spots at the same time.'
say_this_by_group.group_c: Say: 'Core aeration involves mechanically removing soil plugs to relieve compaction, enabling proper water, nutrient, and oxygen absorption. Overseeding is performed concurrently with premium grass seed to fill in thin areas.'
say_this_by_group.group_d: Keep it simple: 'Breaks up hard soil so water and fertilizer can get to the roots. Fills in bare spots with new seed. One time in fall, big difference the next spring.'

intents.then: After explanation, return to lawn program pricing or move to tree/shrub/mosquito.
mined_examples: What about aeration?
One is the aeration.
This is no aeration.

intents.label: Soil amendments / lime / sulfur

say_this_by_group.group_a: Say: 'Soil amendments like lime adjust the soil pH so the lawn can actually use the fertilizer we're putting down. Usually once a year, based on soil condition.'
say_this_by_group.group_b: The reason soil amendments matter: 'If the pH is off, fertilizer just sits there — grass can't absorb it. Lime raises pH, sulfur lowers it. Depending on your soil, we recommend one or the other to make everything else we do work better.'
say_this_by_group.group_c: Say: 'Soil amendments, specifically lime applications, adjust soil pH to optimize fertilizer uptake. Applied annually based on soil assessment. This maximizes effectiveness of your fertilization program.'
say_this_by_group.group_d: Keep it simple: 'Lime makes everything else work better by fixing the soil chemistry. One time a year.'

intents.then: Do NOT quote specific pH values or soil chemistry claims unless verified. Verify in TruSource.
intents.check: TG does not perform soil tests on-site — do not promise soil testing.

intents.label: Continuous service compliance language

say_this_by_group.group_a: Say verbatim: 'These services are continuous. You can modify or cancel anytime by giving us a call.' Required compliance.
say_this_by_group.group_b: The required close: 'Your account is set to continuous service, which means we come out automatically each year. You can cancel or modify anytime with one call.'
say_this_by_group.group_c: Required: 'This is a continuous service account — services recur annually unless you contact us to modify or cancel.'
say_this_by_group.group_d: Soft but required: 'Just so you know, this is continuous service — we come out each year unless you tell us otherwise. Cancel anytime, no issues.'

intents.then: Required for compliance wrap-up — must be said before ending the call.
intents.check: Verify current continuous service language in TruSource — may change by region.

intents.label: Edging / trimming / weed-whacking question

say_this_by_group.group_a: We don't edge or trim — we're a treatment company, not a maintenance company. Your mowing service handles that. We just focus on what makes the lawn healthy underneath.
say_this_by_group.group_b: Here's the scope distinction: TruGreen is a treatment and fertilization service. Mowing, edging, and trimming are maintenance services, typically handled by a landscaping company separately.
say_this_by_group.group_c: TruGreen services encompass fertilization, weed control, pest control, and related treatments. Lawn maintenance activities including mowing, edging, and trimming fall outside our service scope.
say_this_by_group.group_d: We don't edge or trim — that's a mowing/landscaping company's thing. We just focus on treating the lawn to make it healthy.

intents.then: After clarifying scope, pivot to what we DO provide.
intents.check: DO NOT promise edging/trimming/mowing — not approved TruGreen services.

intents.label: Moles, voles, gophers

say_this_by_group.group_a: We don't treat moles/voles/gophers directly — those are rodent control, not our scope. But we do treat grubs, which is what often draws them. Grub control = fewer moles.
say_this_by_group.group_b: Here's the deal with moles: they're after grubs. We treat grubs preventatively, which usually reduces mole activity significantly. For active mole trapping, you'd need a pest control company.
say_this_by_group.group_c: Moles, voles, and gophers are classified as vertebrate rodents and are outside our scope. However, our grub control program addresses the primary food source, which typically reduces activity.
say_this_by_group.group_d: We don't do moles directly — different kind of pest. But we treat grubs, which is what they're eating. Fix the grubs, mole activity usually drops.

intents.then: If customer insists on mole treatment, refer to a licensed wildlife control company.
intents.check: DO NOT promise mole treatment — not an approved TruGreen service.

intents.label: New sod / newly seeded lawn

say_this_by_group.group_a: Hold up — if the sod/seed is less than 6 weeks old, we wait before applying anything to let roots establish. Can you tell me when it was installed?
say_this_by_group.group_b: Here's why we wait: new sod and seeded lawns need 4-6 weeks for root establishment before fertilizer or weed control. When was it installed?
say_this_by_group.group_c: Freshly installed sod or seed requires an establishment period of 4-6 weeks prior to treatment application. May I ask the installation date?
say_this_by_group.group_d: Great you've got new sod — just want to make sure we start at the right time. When was it put in? Usually we wait 4-6 weeks.

intents.then: Confirm sod/seed age before scheduling first service. Document in TruView.
intents.check: Treatment timing varies by establishment status — verify first-service wait window in TruView.

intents.label: Cancel just one service (not whole account)

say_this_by_group.group_a: No problem — we can drop just that one service and keep the rest active. Which one do you want to cancel?
say_this_by_group.group_b: Here's how partial cancellation works: we remove just the service you don't want and keep the others going. Zero impact on the remaining services.
say_this_by_group.group_c: Selective service cancellation is accommodated. Which service would you like to remove, with other services continuing uninterrupted?
say_this_by_group.group_d: Yeah — we can drop just that one. The others stay the same. Which service is it?

intents.then: Process partial cancellation in TruView and confirm remaining services with customer.

intents.label: Referral code / promo code entry

say_this_by_group.group_a: If you've got a referral or promo code, I can apply it right now. What's the code?
say_this_by_group.group_b: Here's how codes work: enter the referral or promo code at the time of signup, and the discount applies to the first service or program total. What's the code?
say_this_by_group.group_c: Promotional and referral codes may be applied at enrollment. Would you provide the code so I can confirm its validity and apply the discount?
say_this_by_group.group_d: No problem — got a code? Give it to me and I'll make sure it applies.

intents.then: Validate code in TruView before confirming discount amount.

intents.label: Irrigation / sprinkler system

say_this_by_group.group_a: Good to know you've got irrigation. Our tech works around sprinkler heads. If you ever need to adjust the schedule, we recommend 1 inch per week in two sessions.
say_this_by_group.group_b: Here's how we work with irrigation: our tech marks and avoids sprinkler heads. For best lawn health, we suggest 1 inch per week in two deep watering sessions.
say_this_by_group.group_c: Our technicians are trained to work around irrigation systems. Optimal watering is approximately 1 inch per week, delivered in two deeper sessions.
say_this_by_group.group_d: No worries about the sprinklers — the tech knows how to work around them. If you want a watering tip, 1 inch per week in two sessions is ideal.

intents.then: Note irrigation system in TruView for tech reference.

intents.label: Can I prepay just some services

say_this_by_group.group_a: You can prepay a portion if you want — but the full-year discount only applies when you prepay all services. Partial means standard pricing on those visits.
say_this_by_group.group_b: Here's how partial prepay works: you can prepay any number of services, but the 5% annual discount is specifically for prepaying the full year. Partial = regular price.
say_this_by_group.group_c: Partial prepayment is accommodated. The annual prepay discount of approximately 5% applies only to full-season prepayment. Partial prepayments are at standard rate.
say_this_by_group.group_d: Yes — you can prepay just some services. Keep in mind the discount is only for the full year, so partial means regular price on those visits.

intents.then: After explaining, offer full PrePay or EasyPay as alternatives.
intents.check: Verify current partial prepay policy in TruView.

intents.label: Flea and tick program

say_this_by_group.group_a: Flea & Tick program hits the yard every 30 days during active season — knocks out fleas, ticks, chiggers. Big one if you've got pets or kids outside.
say_this_by_group.group_b: Here's how Flea & Tick works: targeted granular or liquid treatments every 30 days during peak season. Covers fleas, ticks, chiggers, earwigs, spiders. Important if pets or kids play in the yard.
say_this_by_group.group_c: Our Flea & Tick program delivers monthly treatments during pest-active season, targeting fleas, ticks, chiggers, and related insects. Particularly recommended for households with pets or young children.
say_this_by_group.group_d: Flea & Tick is monthly during the season — kills the stuff that bites your pets and family. Especially important with dogs.

intents.then: After addressing, bundle to full outdoor protection package.
intents.check: Verify current Flea & Tick inclusion and pricing in TruView.

intents.label: Fire ants

say_this_by_group.group_a: Fire ants are serious — our perimeter pest doesn't fully cover mounds. We can do a targeted mound treatment on top of the regular program.
say_this_by_group.group_b: Here's how we handle fire ants: regular perimeter treatment helps near the structure, but active mounds in the yard need targeted treatment. Separate product, usually one application does it.
say_this_by_group.group_c: Fire ant control is a specialized treatment distinct from perimeter pest services. A targeted mound treatment is applied to active colonies.
say_this_by_group.group_d: Fire ants need special treatment — the perimeter stuff doesn't fully cut it. We'd do a targeted mound app for those.

intents.then: If customer has fire ants, bundle fire ant treatment with perimeter pest.
intents.check: Verify fire ant treatment availability by branch in TruView — may vary by region.

intents.label: Ticks / Lyme disease concern

say_this_by_group.group_a: Flea & tick program handles ticks on the property. Big deal if you've got pets or kids — one tick can transmit Lyme. We treat monthly during tick season.
say_this_by_group.group_b: Here's the tick strategy: Flea & Tick program applies monthly treatments during tick season targeting active populations. Important for households with pets, children, or outdoor use given disease transmission risk.
say_this_by_group.group_c: Our Flea & Tick program delivers monthly treatments during active season, targeting tick populations with particular benefit for households with pets or children due to disease transmission concerns.
say_this_by_group.group_d: Ticks are serious — one bite can mean Lyme. Our flea & tick program hits them monthly during the season. Big deal if you've got pets or kids.

intents.then: Bundle Flea & Tick for households with pets/children.

intents.label: Pollinator / bee / butterfly concern
